characters.description: The last gunslinger of Gilead, leading his ka-tet along the path of the Beam toward the Dark Tower. Bound by an old code that obliges gunslingers to aid those in need, he agrees to help defend a farming town, even as the quest and his companions' hidden burdens press on him.
characters.name: Roland Deschain

characters.description: A young man from New York, drawn into Mid-World and now a seasoned gunslinger of the ka-tet, married to Susannah. Quick-thinking and increasingly capable, he shares fully in the burdens of the quest.
characters.name: Eddie Dean

characters.description: A woman from 1960s New York, drawn into Mid-World and made whole from a once-divided self. She uses a wheelchair, having lost her legs before she came, and rides with the ka-tet as a gunslinger, married to Eddie. She carries a growing secret about her own body as the journey continues.
characters.name: Susannah Dean

characters.description: A boy from New York, drawn into Mid-World and now a full gunslinger of the ka-tet, close to Eddie and Susannah and bonded to the billy-bumbler Oy. He grows in confidence and skill on the road.
characters.name: Jake Chambers

characters.description: A billy-bumbler, a small, clever animal of Mid-World that can echo human speech, devoted to Jake and to the whole company.
characters.name: Oy

characters.description: The priest of Calla Bryn Sturgis, the farming town the ka-tet comes to. A former Catholic priest from another world's version of America, he fled his old parish after a supernatural evil overwhelmed it and wandered between worlds before settling here. Haunted and hard-drinking but brave, he keeps a dangerous object hidden and becomes an ally to Roland's cause.
characters.name: Father Callahan

characters.description: A young farmer of Calla Bryn Sturgis who dares to speak against the town's long submission to the Wolves, raiders who come each generation to steal children. Frightened but determined, he rallies his neighbors to seek help from the passing gunslingers.
characters.name: Tian Jaffords
